# Velloux — Web Design & Development Agency, Pune, India

## Who We Are
Velloux is a professional website design and development agency based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. We build custom, high-performance websites for businesses across Pune and surrounding areas including Kharadi, Hinjewadi, Baner, Wakad, Viman Nagar, and Pimpri-Chinchwad.

## What We Do
- Custom Website Development in Pune
- E-Commerce Website Development (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom)
- Website Redesign & Modernisation
- UI/UX Design
- Landing Page Design
- Local SEO for Pune businesses
- Web Application Development

## Why Choose Velloux
- Pune-based agency with local market expertise
- Mobile-first, SEO-ready websites
- No templates — every website is custom built
- Post-launch support included
- Transparent pricing
- Serving startups, SMEs, and enterprises in Pune

## Service Areas
Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Kharadi, Hinjewadi, Baner, Wakad, Viman Nagar, Koregaon Park, Hadapsar, Kalyani Nagar, Maharashtra, India.
